summary: Portal-gate blink control: repeatedly cross strange ETB creatures through artifact doors, then close the passage with Mirror and Containment Priest.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Creature and artifact portals repeatedly reuse ETB and leave-battlefield effects for cards, removal, recursion, and tempo.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Literal portal artifacts, two transforming gateways, Tezzeret's activation discount, Prototype Portal copies, and artifact blink form a real engine.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Bounce, prison Auras, Floodgate, Renet, Wall of Tears, and Sentinel control combat and permanent development.

tags.name: etb effects
tags.reason: Twenty creatures give the blink engines repeatable removal, selection, card advantage, recursion, protection, and mass bounce.

tags.name: flash
tags.reason: Heliod's back face, Renet, Containment Priest, Whitemane Lion, Portal Manipulator, and Emergence Zone support opponent-turn portal play.

tags.name: stax
tags.reason: Mirror of Life Trapping delays cast creatures, while Containment Priest can strand those returns and shut non-cast entries until bounced.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Chrome Host Seedshark, Aether Channeler, Multiversal Recruitment, Sunder the Gateway, and Xerex Strobe-Knight create the combat board.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Gate to the Aether and Mirror of Life Trapping add uncertainty, but the deck can exploit their entry patterns.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Portal Manipulator, Coercive Portal, and Phyrexian Portal still create table decisions, but politics is no longer a major axis.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: The mana package exists to reach the expensive portals, but it is support rather than the deck's identity.

tags.name: spell copy
tags.reason: Invasion of Vryn and See Double can copy the right spell at the right moment, but the list is not primarily a copy deck.

tags.name: battles
tags.reason: Invasion of Vryn remains a useful threshold card, but battles are now incidental.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Portal to Phyrexia can reanimate opposing creatures, but theft is incidental.
